## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `develop` (or `main` for a hotfix).
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm lint:pkg` passes.
- [ ] Logic changes come with tests that failed before the change.
- [ ] A changeset is added if a published package changed (`pnpm changeset`).
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior or APIs changed.
